---
title: Configure Xcode compilation caching to use Depot Cache
ogTitle: Configure Xcode compilation caching to use Depot Cache
description: Learn how to use Depot remote caching for Xcode builds
---

Starting with [**Xcode 26**](https://developer.apple.com/xcode/), Xcode includes compilation caching, built on the LLVM content-addressable storage (CAS). Compilation caching reuses previously compiled outputs, which speeds up clean builds and builds after you switch branches.

[**Depot Cache**](/docs/cache/overview) provides a remote cache service that works with Xcode compilation caching, so you can store and reuse compiled outputs across builds on your CI/CD systems.

## Local workstation

Depot Cache doesn't support Xcode compilation caching on local workstations yet. If you need local support, [reach out to support](/help).

## Depot GitHub Actions runners

[Depot GitHub Actions runners](/docs/github-actions/overview) are pre-configured to use Depot Cache with Xcode, so you don't need any additional configuration. Builds that use a version of Xcode earlier than 26 aren't affected and run as before.

Run your Xcode builds as normal:

```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: depot-macos-26
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - run: xcodebuild build -project "$PROJECT" -scheme "$SCHEME" -destination "$DESTINATION" | xcbeautify
```

The runner configures Xcode through a file referenced by the `XCODE_XCCONFIG_FILE` environment variable. If your job sets its own `XCODE_XCCONFIG_FILE`, the runner leaves it unchanged and Xcode doesn't use Depot Cache.

The runner's file sets the following build settings:

```toml
COMPILATION_CACHE_ENABLE_CACHING=YES
COMPILATION_CACHE_ENABLE_PLUGIN=YES
COMPILATION_CACHE_ENABLE_DETACHED_KEY_QUERIES=YES
COMPILATION_CACHE_ENABLE_INTEGRATED_QUERIES=YES
SWIFT_USE_INTEGRATED_DRIVER=YES
CLANG_ENABLE_MODULES=YES
SWIFT_ENABLE_PREFIX_MAPPING=$(inherited)
SWIFT_ENABLE_PROJECT_PREFIX_MAPPING=YES
CLANG_ENABLE_PREFIX_MAPPING=YES
CLANG_ENABLE_PROJECT_PREFIX_MAPPING=YES
COMPILATION_CACHE_REMOTE_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = swift c c++ objective-c objective-c++
DEPOT_XCODE_CACHE_PREFIX_MAPPINGS=$(SYMROOT)=/^symroot $(OBJROOT)=/^objroot $(SDK_STAT_CACHE_DIR)=/^dd $(HOME)=/^home
SWIFT_OTHER_PREFIX_MAPPINGS = $(inherited) $(DEPOT_XCODE_CACHE_PREFIX_MAPPINGS)
CLANG_OTHER_PREFIX_MAPPINGS = $(inherited) $(DEPOT_XCODE_CACHE_PREFIX_MAPPINGS)
```

The value of `SWIFT_ENABLE_PREFIX_MAPPING` comes from the upstream Xcode configuration as it can break non-compatible customer builds. When not set to `YES`, it can decrease the cache hit ratio.

If these settings conflict with your project's build settings and cause builds to fail, turn off automatic configuration.

To turn off automatic configuration for your organization, disable **Allow Actions jobs to automatically connect to Depot Cache** in your organization settings.

To opt out specific jobs or workflows, set the `DEPOT_XCODE_CACHE_ENABLED` environment variable to `0`:

```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: depot-macos-26
    env:
      DEPOT_XCODE_CACHE_ENABLED: 0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - run: xcodebuild build -project "$PROJECT" -scheme "$SCHEME" -destination "$DESTINATION" | xcbeautify
```

### View cache statistics

To see how well the cache performs, such as the hit rate and how much data the build downloaded, add the [`depot/xcode-compilation-cache-summary`](https://github.com/depot/xcode-compilation-cache-summary) action to your job. Add it after your build step. The action collects statistics at the end of the job.

```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: depot-macos-26
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - run: xcodebuild build -project "$PROJECT" -scheme "$SCHEME" -destination "$DESTINATION" | xcbeautify
      - uses: depot/xcode-compilation-cache-summary@v1
```

When the job finishes, the action prints a summary to the job log:

```text
Depot Xcode compilation cache
  Hits        5310
  Misses      0
  Hit rate    100.0%
  Downloaded  2.2 GB
  Uploaded    0 objects, 0 B
```

The action also adds these statistics to the GitHub Actions job summary.

To enable detailed logging and list the cache keys that missed, set the `debug` input to `true`:

```yaml
- uses: depot/xcode-compilation-cache-summary@v1
  with:
    debug: true
```
